names.dexter_house_1721_prairie: 1721 Prairie Avenue — Wirt Dexter house, Arthur Little's front of 1889

source.citation: George Glessner, [Wirt Dexter house, 1721 S. Prairie Avenue, before the front addition], c. 1888. Photograph in the Glessner House Museum's George Glessner photographs, reproduced on its blog, 'The Early History of Prairie Avenue - Part IV' (2020-07-07).
what_it_does_not_supply: the lamp's exact place along the block: it stands near the camera
what_it_supplies: a gas street lamp on the west parkway of Prairie Avenue opposite 1721, and its form: fluted post, ladder bar, tapered four-sided lantern under a pyramidal cap
